note: Rewritten from the species-level description in Roonwal & Chhotani 1989, Fauna of India: Isoptera; the original is in English and covers three castes: Imago, Soldier and Worker, the alate being explicitly stated there to rest on the literature with no specimens seen. OCR problems: the worker head width appears in the original as '0.75-95 mm' (a 0. probably dropped) and is written here as 0.75—0.95 mm; 'PusitlypetB s ubtrap e toidal' is read as postclypeus subtrapezoidal.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate (after the literature): pronotum small, its anterior margin produced forwards in the middle into a sharp, pointed umbilical process (umbilicate), lateral angles acute; body 8.0 mm long with wings, 3.5 mm without. Soldier body 4.50—5.0 mm long, head length (to mandible base) 1.5—1.55 mm, anterior margin of the pronotum strongly and sharply produced forwards, without a notch; postmentum with a long and very narrow waist. Worker body 3.5—3.9 mm long.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: No specimens seen in the original; the description follows the literature. Rust-coloured; antennae darker, brown; margins of the pronotum, legs and ventral surface of the abdomen paler, pale yellow; wings greyish grey, costa brown. Body densely covered with fine hairs. Body length 8.0 mm with wings, 3.5 mm without. Head triangular, strongly flattened and concave; compound eyes medium-sized, slightly protruding. Ocelli oval, situated near the compound eyes. Antennae 15-segmented; slightly longer than the head; moderately thick, gradually thicker towards the apex; segments 1—3 cylindrical; the following 5 segments very small. Pronotum small, narrower than the head; anterior margin produced forwards in the middle into a sharp, pointed, navel-like process (umbilicate); lateral angles acute; sides and posterior margin curved into a crescent. Abdomen oval; abdominal appendages small. Legs short and thick. Wings 3 times as long as wide; covered with fine hairs; wing scales very small, triangular. Costa and radius moderately thick, close to each other; remaining veins fine, media indistinct.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule, pronotum, body and legs pale golden yellow to reddish yellow; mandibles pale reddish brown, paler at the base; antennae pale yellow. Head and body densely pilose. Body length 4.50—5.0 mm. Head triangular to oval; dorsoventrally flattened; widest slightly behind the middle, strongly narrowing forwards from there; sides rounded; posterior margin concave with a median elevation; posterior angles acute; head length (to mandible base) 1.5—1.55 mm, maximum head width 1.44—1.55 mm. Frontal gland pore small, circular, situated before the middle of the head. Compound eyes and ocelli absent. Antennae 14—15-segmented; segment 2 about as long as segment 3 or longer. Postclypeus subtrapezoidal, pilose; anteclypeus transparent, thin, band-like. Labrum leaf-shaped, tapering to a short transparent apical point; much longer than wide (length 0.65 mm, width 0.35 mm). Mandibles rather thick, sword-shaped, strongly incurved anteriorly; length 0.95—0.98 mm; each mandible with one or two crenate notches on the broader base. Postmentum club-shaped, with a long and very narrow waist (length 1.25 mm, maximum width 0.43—0.45 mm, width at the waist 0.10—0.13 mm). Pronotum flat, subtriangular, fan-shaped; anterior margin strongly and sharply produced forwards, without a notch; posterior margin rounded (length 0.40—0.45 mm, width 0.65 mm). Legs short and stout; the dorsal spur of the fore tibia not distinct in the specimens examined. Abdomen oval, long; cerci 2-segmented; no styli seen in the specimens examined.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head pale yellowish white; body white. Head and body densely pilose. Body length 3.5—3.9 mm. Head subtriangular, head capsule subquadrate, flat, broad posteriorly; width slightly greater than the head length (to mandible base) (length 0.65—0.73 mm, width 0.75—0.95 mm). Postclypeus flat, short, pilose. Labrum dome-shaped. Antennae 15-segmented; segments 3 and 5 short and about equal in length. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum as in the soldier but with a weaker anterior process (length 0.23—0.26 mm, width 0.38—0.53 mm). Legs and abdomen as in the soldier.
